title: LLM Tool Definition v1
description: A bounded description of one tool available to a model. It contains no executable code, path, command, credential, or provider-specific callback.

name.description: Stable caller-selected tool name used to match a model request to an injected invoker.

description.description: Bounded human-readable explanation of the tool's purpose and safe use.
examples: Read one bounded record by logical identifier.

inputSchema.description: JSON text containing the tool argument schema. It is parsed and compiled by the library without network retrieval.

examples.name: read_record
